composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 of 196D5023 documents point-to-point wiring/pinouts for two nearly identical BEL harness segments labeled BEL1-S and BEL2-S. Net naming "G3-S3..." (top block) and "G3-S4..." (bottom block) plus terminal strip labels BEL1-S/BEL2-S directly match register nodes for BEL units 629-bel1-s and 629-bel2-s (BEL1 STBD / BEL2 STBD, BAE System class 629). Each block feeds a BEL connector (RTN1), a SYNC twisted-pair connector, and a CAN-A bus connector (Shield/HI/LO), constituting the device's own loop membership (CAN bus neighbours, sync signal, battery return) rather than shared infrastructure — the CAN-A/SYNC backbone routing itself (splice ovals, daisy-chain crossing) is treated as infrastructure under the BEL system since it interconnects multiple BEL units on the same bus.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip labeled 'BEL1-S' with all net names prefixed 'G3-S3...' (S3 chain segment) directly names this BEL unit; pin call-outs and connector groups (BEL RTN1, SYNC, CAN-A) are its I/O loop membership.

functions.label: Battery return / chain supply & output interface
functions.what_it_does: Provides the BEL1-S unit's battery return, chain supply, and chain output connections that link it into the daisy-chain sensor/actuator power path; frequency-select, enable, and address lines (ADR_0/ADR_1) configure the unit's identity on the chain but are shown not-connected (N/C) on this build.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN from terminal strip BEL1-S pin 7 via wire to BEL connector pin RTN1 (also carries SYNC_RTN return); G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT from pin 11 continues the chain; G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY from pin 10 supplies downstream chain segment
G3-S329 ENABLE (pin1), G3-S300a ADR_0 (pin8), G3-S300b ADR_1 (pin9) terminate at strip but marked N/C — no downstream connection

functions.dry_data: Point-to-point pinout, no protective devices shown; pins 2,7,11,3,1,8,9,5,6,N/C,10,4 per strip BEL1-S

functions.label: SYNC signal pair
functions.what_it_does: Carries the SYNC timing/handshake signal and its return between the BEL1-S terminal strip and the SYNC connector, synchronizing chain segment S3 with the bus timing reference.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3S2 SYNC from BEL1-S pin 3 via crossed twisted-pair wiring to SYNC connector pin 3; G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN (shared with VBATTERY RTN net) via wire to SYNC connector pin 10

functions.dry_data: Twisted pair, wire crossing (X) shown between strip and SYNC connector

functions.label: CAN-A bus interface
functions.what_it_does: Connects BEL1-S onto the CAN-A data bus (Shield/HI/LO) for chain segment S3, enabling digital communication with adjacent chain devices; shield/LO run through a splice/drain point before reaching the CAN-A connector.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3AH CANA_HI from BEL1-S pin 5 via wire to CAN-A connector HI pin; G3-S3AL CANA_LO from pin 6 via wire (through dashed-oval splice/drain point) to CAN-A connector LO pin; G3-S3AS CANA_Shield (N/C at strip) via wire through dashed-oval splice to CAN-A connector Shield pin

key_components: dashed-oval splice/shield-drain point on Shield and LO lines
functions.dry_data: CAN bus 3-conductor (Shield/HI/LO), splice/drain indicated by dashed oval symbol, no rating data on sheet

functions.label: SYNC signal pair

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S4S2 SYNC from BEL2-S pin 3 via crossed twisted-pair wiring to SYNC connector pin 4; G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN (shared with VBATTERY RTN net) via wire to SYNC connector pin 9

facts: Sheet 12 of dwg 196D5023 is a point-to-point wiring/pinout diagram for two BEL chain segments (S3 and S4), each with a BEL1-S / BEL2-S terminal strip feeding a BEL connector (RTN1), a SYNC twisted-pair connector, and a CAN-A bus connector (Shield/HI/LO)
No protective devices (fuses/breakers), switches, relays, or PLC outputs are depicted on this sheet — purely wiring pinouts
Twisted-pair wire crossings (X symbols) are shown on SYNC and CAN-A LO/Shield runs between terminal strip and connectors on both blocks, indicating standard bus daisy-chain cabling practice
Dashed-oval symbols on CANA_Shield and CANA_LO lines on both blocks indicate splice or shield-drain termination points along the bus run
Sheet title block: CAGE 89954, DWG 196D5023, SHEET 12 OF 47, SIZE D, SCALE NONE, drawn by G. Zaleski (BAE Systems Controls, Endicott NY), no revisions recorded
